layout: Every picture leaves room for the game: open sky or another quiet area at the top center, where the cannon hangs; plain lower corners, where the flippers swing; a calm lower strip; and large, clearly readable shapes that a layout can follow. No people, animals, characters or faces, no text, signage or logos, no brand products, and nothing that resembles the original game's pictures or characters.

stages.palette: A fairy-tale sky high above the clouds: powder-blue to soft cornflower sky, cream and white cumulus clouds with blue-gray shading, small accents of sage, dusty teal and warm sand. Even daylight. Light to medium values where pegs sit; no large areas of saturated green, orange or magenta.

A burrow country under a clover meadow: pale sky and meadow above, light sandy earth, pale clay and biscuit-colored soil, roots, pebbles and garden treasures below, accents of muted sage, clover green, cream and soft cocoa. Picture-book light, the ground as bright as the meadow; no dark brown earth and no large areas of saturated green.

The rooftops of an old hill town at golden hour: gabled roofs in slate blue and gray-violet, walls of honey and cream stone, chimneys, towers, balconies, washing lines and lanterns under a sky from pale butter yellow to hazy blue, accents of muted gold, dusty rose and sage. Warm low sun with soft shadows; no orange sunset sky, nothing Egyptian.

A dreamy pastel outer space that is never black: lilac, periwinkle and lavender nebula haze, pale silver stars, ringed planets and moons with soft craters, comets with pale trails, accents of pale gold, soft teal and pearl gray. No black or near-black space and no large areas of saturated purple or magenta.

A sunny seaside cove: aqua and turquoise water with white foam, pale sand, weathered gray-blue piers and pilings, sea-washed rocks, a white lighthouse, rope, nets, buoys and lobster traps under a soft blue sky, accents of cream, pale teal, driftwood gray and muted coral. Bright midday light; no sea creatures and no large areas of saturated green, orange or magenta.

A pumpkin hollow at moonlit dusk: plum and dusty mauve sky, a pale silver moon and mist, pumpkins, curling vines, crooked fences, bare trees and old stone, accents of silver-lilac, slate blue and pale cream. Medium values that never turn dark or black; no orange pumpkins and no large areas of saturated green, orange or magenta.

Terraced flower gardens in late spring: blossoms in dusty rose, blush and cream with butter-yellow accents, muted sage leaves and hedges, pale stone walls and steps, trellises, a water mill and a pond under a clear soft sky. Clear morning light; no large areas of saturated pink, magenta, green or orange.

A country fair on a breezy afternoon: striped tents and booths in cream and muted brick red, straw bales, bunting, rosettes and ribbons, rides of painted wood and pale-gold metal under a soft turquoise sky with white clouds. Bright afternoon light; no cards, dice or magic, no large areas of saturated red, green, orange or magenta.

A volcanic highland under a hazy pale-gold sky: blue-gray basalt columns, sandstone ledges and arches, terraced hot springs with milky aqua water and steam, a distant smoking volcano, tiny embers as the only bright touches, accents of dusty rose, warm sand and pale amber. No lava rivers, no castle, no large areas of saturated orange, red, green or magenta.

A quiet silver birch forest at misty dawn: white and silver birch trunks, silver-blue mist, still mirror pools, river stones and cairns, ferns and moss in gray-green, a pale lemon dawn, accents of pale lilac and birch-bark cream. Diffuse light; no dark forest shadows, no temple and no yin-yang.

The snowy summit above all the worlds at twilight: a luminous teal and dusty blue sky lighter toward a pale gold horizon, gold and silver stars, faint ice-blue aurora, snowy peaks, ice spires and frozen terraces in ice blue and pearl, brass and silver sky instruments, a sea of clouds far below. Medium values that never turn dark; no green aurora.
